title: ANI: Adaptive Numerical Injection for Unifying Semantic and Arithmetic Representations in Numerical Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Precise numerical reasoning with Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for expanding their applicability to complex real-world tasks. However, text-based tokenization often fragments numbers, significantly hindering precise arithmetic reasoning. Meanwhile, numerical embeddings, despite arithmetic precision, rely on context-agnostic substitution that disregards the semantic role of numbers as identifiers. To combine the complementary strengths, we propose \textbf{ANI (Adaptive Numerical Injection)}, a hybrid framework that governs the selective injection of numerical features based on the semantic context. By employing a context-aware gating mechanism, we selectively inject numerical embeddings (specifically FoNE) into the latent space, explicitly preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands. Through extensive evaluations across various LLMs, we demonstrate that ANI enhances MATH performance by 9.5 points over

translated_title: ANI：自适应数值注入——统一数值推理中的语义与算术表示
translated_abstract: 精确的数值推理对于大型语言模型（LLM）拓展其在复杂真实世界任务中的应用至关重要。然而，基于文本的分词方式常常会将数字碎片化，严重阻碍了精确的算术推理。与此同时，数值嵌入虽然具备算术精度，却依赖于与上下文无关的替换方式，忽视了数字作为标识符的语义角色。为了结合两者的互补优势，我们提出了ANI（自适应数值注入），这是一个基于语义上下文来控制数值特征选择性注入的混合框架。通过采用上下文感知的门控机制，我们选择性地将数值嵌入（具体为FoNE）注入到潜在空间中，在明确保留名义标识符的同时增强量化操作数。通过对多种LLM的广泛评估，我们证明ANI在MATH数据集上的性能提升了9.5个百分点。
tldr: 提出自适应数值注入框架ANI，利用上下文感知门控机制选择性地将数值嵌入（FoNE）注入LLM潜在空间，在保留数字语义标识符的同时显著提升算术推理精度，使MATH性能提升9.5个百分点。
en_tdlr: ANI is a hybrid framework that employs a context-aware gating mechanism to selectively inject numerical embeddings (FoNE) into LLMs' latent space, preserving nominal identifiers while enhancing quantitative operands, thereby improving MATH performance by 9.5 points.
